summary: Every full-history workflow checkout is a one-commit checkout plus one fetch of all branches and tags that leaves out refs/tags/evidence/*, so evidence records can become protected tags without adding their objects to every CI job.

replay.detail: Workflow checkouts only; CI fetches the same branches and tags as before, without refs/tags/evidence/*.
